title:
Base type for metadata that is provisioned by c3 application package.

By default, users cannot update metadata. However, the application can be in the development mode with
live metadata ON in which case metadata can be updated. Deploying a new version of an application will always
override live update but live updates can be promoted to application source repository as a new branch if source
control is configured.

Metadata needs to mixin either `Named` or `Identified` and instances can be retrieved using either `forName` or
`forId` respectively.

Metadata content is authored under `/metadata/` folder in c3 application package.

Note that metadata in a depending package can be remixed by a root package by authoring updated version with same
`name` or `id`. {@link Jsn#merge(base, remix, true, true)} logic is used to perform the remix operation.

Similarly if application is deployed in the test mode then metadata defined under `/test/metadata/` is remixed
with base.

@see Config
@see SeedData
